description: This file defines a PHP class named License that extends ListableDisplayField. It appears to be part of a reporting system within the OrangeHRM application, specifically related to displaying license information within reports. The class provides methods to retrieve the DTO class, entity aliases, and fields specific to license display in reports.

classes.name: License
classes.description: A class representing a display field for license information in report generation, extending the ListableDisplayField base class.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) associated with this display field, which is Dto\License.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides the entity aliases used within the report context, specifically returning ['license'].

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of field names relevant for this display field, specifically ['employee.empNumber'].
